details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2410-2413 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In unblock_resolve_own_prs, a failed read of the MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_LABEL repository variable (5xx, rate limit, 403, network error) is treated like a 404 "never set" because of `2>/dev/null ... || true`, so it falls back to `ai:merge-lease-wait` and the parser still returns `status: ok`.
  WHY: In a consumer with a custom wait label, an own PR that carries that label and has a pending or absent head gate gets `lease_wait=false`, `own_pr_guard` returns None, and `_own_pr_retire_ops` emits a "Superseded by" comment plus `close pr:true` on a lease-waiting PR, which is the G2 case that must refuse; four reviewers rated it MAJOR and gemini gave no severity.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2410-2412 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The REST read of MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_LABEL is gated only on a non-empty GraphQL response file and an unset env var, so it runs for every issue judged from unblock_judge.yml, including issues with no `ai/issue-<item>` own-PR node or no `reissue` verdict.
  WHY: It adds one GitHub API call per judged issue beyond the §15 G1 budget ("one pulls read per judged issue ... plus one statuses read per own pull request"), contrary to CLAUDE.md §14; four reviewers rated it NIT and gemini gave no severity.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2474-2478 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In unblock_reissue_own_pr_guard, when posting the refusal comment fails, the function logs `outcome=skip reason=record_failed` and returns 0, and no `ai:unblock-wait:v1` marker is recorded on the issue.
  WHY: `unblock_scan.py` suppression (`recent_verdict`, MARKER_PREFIXES) relies on that marker, so the item becomes eligible again once the in-flight window ends, and every tick repeats the model run and the GraphQL read while posting keeps failing; all three rated it NIT.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1656 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: When posting the refusal comment fails, the judge logs the failure and returns success without recording a wait marker.
  WHY: With no marker, the issue can be judged again after the in-flight window expires, which repeats the expensive model run while comment posting keeps failing; no severity was stated (low used as the floor), and this is likely the same root cause as the 2474-2478 entry but is not merged because the line ranges do not overlap.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3954-3978 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_merge_lease_not_planned_source_prs` caps `lease_issues` at the first 50 distinct source issues (lines 3956-3958), so `lease_closed` contains only the queried issues and the final awk at line 3978 never returns PRs whose source issue ranks beyond 50.
  WHY: With more than 50 `ai/issue-<n>` waiters on a base, a NOT_PLANNED orphan beyond the cap is granted the lease silently and the `reason=source_issue_not_planned` skip never fires; rated MAJOR.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "G4 gets `MERGE_LEASE_SOURCE_ISSUE_GUARD_ENABLED`, default `true`", with `false` restoring today's grant.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml, lease-tick step env blocks next to MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_LABEL / MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED (lines 263-271 and 1030-1038)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: review_autofix_sweep.yml exports MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_LABEL (lines 266, 1034) and MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED (lines 267, 1035) but not MERGE_LEASE_SOURCE_ISSUE_GUARD_ENABLED, and the file is not in the PR diff, so setting the variable to `false` has no effect on this tick, which keeps the script default `true`; README.md and the agents.d fragment document the omission ("review_autofix_sweep.yml does not forward the lease switch, so its tick uses the script default"); the workflow is outside the plan grant's files_touched; reviewers disagree on severity (MAJOR from gemini and minimax, NIT from sonnet and luna); z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked this gap and rejected it because it is documented and the fallback direction is safe.
- requirement: "The merge-lease grant skips a pull request whose head ref is `ai/issue-<n>` when issue `<n>` is closed with state reason `not_planned`" (issue G4).
  expected_change_site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh, `_merge_lease_not_planned_source_prs`
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The helper checks only the first 50 distinct source issues (`scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3956-3958`), so a waiter whose source issue is past rank 50 is absent from `lease_closed`, the awk at line 3978 cannot emit it, and the PR can be granted a lease; the PR-checks README row promises the guard works "when such a waiter exists" without a cap, while the code documents the cap at line 3922; reviewers disagree on severity (MAJOR from gemini and minimax, NIT from luna); z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected this gap as a documented fail-open design choice with no evidence that the precondition is reachable.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:unblock_resolve_own_prs, lines 2410-2413 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: An unset variable (404) and a set-but-unreadable variable (5xx, rate limit, network error, 403 without "Variables: read") both fall back to `ai:merge-lease-wait`, and `own_prs_from_graphql` still returns `status: ok`, so a failed G1 read of the wait label is never reported as `unknown`.
  WHY: With a custom label, a judge run from unblock_judge.yml, and a failed read, an own PR that carries the custom label and has a pending or absent head gate gets `lease_wait=false`, and `own_pr_guard` returns None. `_own_pr_retire_ops` (unblock_actions.py) then emits "Superseded by" plus `close` `pr: True`. G2 requires this case to refuse ("`unknown` (G1 read failed) also refuses"). It is the only fact that fails open, and the trigger is narrow.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:unblock_resolve_own_prs, line 2410 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The extra REST read runs whenever the GraphQL response file exists and the env var is unset, which is every issue judged from unblock_judge.yml. It runs before any verdict is known, even when no `ai/issue-<item>` node exists.
  WHY: It adds one API call beyond the §15 budget ("one pulls read per judged issue ... plus one statuses read per own pull request"), the call is wasted for issues with no own PR, and it goes against CLAUDE.md §14 "check first, add second".
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  Requirement: "G4 gets `MERGE_LEASE_SOURCE_ISSUE_GUARD_ENABLED`, default `true`", with `false` restoring today's grant.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml, the lease-tick step env blocks next to MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_LABEL at lines 266 and 1034.
  Evidence of absence: The file exports MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_LABEL (lines 266, 1034) and MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED but not the new switch, and it is not in the PR diff, so `false` has no effect on this tick. The omission is documented in README.md and the agents.d fragment and is outside files_touched. It is a partial kill switch, not a safety defect.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (3 related items; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2):
  1. scripts/unblock_judge.sh line 2410: gate the read with a `jq -e` check for a `headRefName == "ai/issue-${ITEM}"` node (2 lines).
  2. scripts/unblock_judge.sh lines 2411-2413: on a non-404 gh failure, write {"status":"unknown","prs":[]} with reason=label_read_failed so the existing `own_pr_unknown` refusal applies (6 lines).
  3. tests/test_unblock_judge.py near line 1704: add `env.pop("MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_LABEL", None)` before `env.update(env_extra)` (1 line).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2410-2413 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: A failed read of the MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_LABEL repository variable (5xx, rate limit, network error) falls back to the default ai:merge-lease-wait without any signal, instead of treating the label state as unknown.
  WHY: With a custom wait label, a lease-waiting PR gets lease_wait=false, own_pr_guard returns None, and the old PR is retired and closed as superseded, despite the re-issue guard's intent to refuse.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2410-2411 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The judge makes an extra REST request for MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_LABEL on every judged issue when the env var is not exported, whether or not an own-PR guard is needed.
  WHY: It exceeds the G1 read budget (one pulls read per judged issue, plus one statuses read per own pull request) and adds API usage and latency.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1656 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When posting the refusal comment fails, the judge logs the failure and returns success without recording a wait marker.
  WHY: The issue can be judged again after the in-flight window expires, which repeats the expensive model run while comment posting keeps failing.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  Requirement: G4 gets MERGE_LEASE_SOURCE_ISSUE_GUARD_ENABLED and the switch defaults to true, with false restoring prior behavior.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml, in the lease-tick environment.
  Evidence of absence: The workflow does not export the switch in its lease-tick env, so setting the variable to false does not disable the guard on this tick, which keeps the script default true.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Requirement: The merge-lease grant skips a pull request whose head ref is ai/issue-<n> when issue <n> is closed with state reason not_planned.
  Expected change site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh, _merge_lease_not_planned_source_prs
  Evidence of absence: The helper truncates its lookup to the first 50 distinct source issues at lines 3956-3958, so waiters beyond the limit are never checked and can be granted a lease incorrectly.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:lines 2410-2413 in unblock_resolve_own_prs | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The read at line 2411 swallows every failure mode (`2>/dev/null || true`), so a transient 5xx, 403 or timeout reads the same as a 404, and `${own_wait_label:-ai:merge-lease-wait}` at line 2413 then uses the default label.
  WHY: With a custom label (e.g. `custom:lease-wait`), a failed variable read, and a successful GraphQL read, own PRs get `lease_wait=false`. `own_pr_guard` returns None, `_own_pr_retire_ops` runs, and the PR gets `Superseded by` plus `close pr:true`, which is the exact G2 refusal case. The agents fragment (line 6) notes the issue, but the code does not distinguish a 404 from other failures.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_merge_lease_not_planned_source_prs, lines 3954-3958 and the final awk at line 3978 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `lease_issues` is capped at the first 50 distinct source issues, and only those are queried. The final awk filters against the full `lease_pairs`, but `lease_closed` contains only the queried issues, so PRs whose source issue is past 50 are never returned.
  WHY: With more than 50 `ai/issue-<n>` NOT_PLANNED waiters, any PR beyond rank 50 is granted the lease silently, and the `reason=source_issue_not_planned` skip never fires.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:unblock_reissue_own_pr_guard, lines 2476-2478 | severity=NI
